description: This Swift extension adds helper properties to the AnyCodable type to facilitate extracting common data types (String, Bool, Int, Double, Dictionary, Array) from an AnyCodable instance, as well as converting its value to foundation-compatible types.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Attempts to cast the wrapped value to a String, returning nil if unsuccessful.

methods.name: boolValue
methods.description: Attempts to extract a Bool value, considering NSNumber types representing booleans.

methods.name: intValue
methods.description: Attempts to extract an Int, handling NSNumber representations while avoiding boolean types.

methods.name: doubleValue
methods.description: Attempts to extract a Double, handling Int and NSNumber types.

methods.name: dictionaryValue
methods.description: Converts the wrapped value into a dictionary of String to AnyCodable if possible.

methods.name: arrayValue
methods.description: Converts the wrapped value into an array of AnyCodable if possible.

methods.name: foundationValue
methods.description: Recursively converts the AnyCodable's value into foundation-compatible types.
